adn.resume_en: 47% show 3D relief/bevel (mean relief 5.1/10), 47% carry contour/rim glow (mean glow 4.4/10), 71% sit on a dark background and 47% on a gradient/atmospheric one, 0% of outlined marks use a thick (usually white) contour, 41% add particles/sparkles. Mean saturation 6.5/10, mean brightness 3.8/10, mean complexity 5.3/10. Dominant materials: plastic 16%, fabric 14%, neon 12%, metal 10%. Dominant palette: #FFFFFF, #0D0D0D, #3FA9F5, #120A18, #0D0F12.

composition: Use a 16:9 landscape or 9:16 vertical split layout with a central 3D character or floating object.
Position massive background typography behind the central subject, covering 40% to 60% of the frame.
Maintain strict symmetry or a 1/3 to 2/3 asymmetrical balance with characters on one side and text blocks on the other.
Incorporate clean horizontal alignments and thin geometric framing lines or UI brackets in the outer 10% margins.
typographie: Use massive, ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif fonts for main titles, often with a vertical gradient (white-to-transparent or color-to-color).
Apply distressed, dripping brush-style lettering exclusively for festive, summer-themed designs.
Set secondary text in clean, wide-spaced, thin geometric sans-serif tech fonts.
Layer text directly behind the foreground character or object to create a strong 3D depth effect.
lumiere: Implement high-contrast low-key lighting with a strong neon rim light (red, purple, pink, or cyan) outlining the subject.
Use soft white key light on the character's face and torso to maintain photographic clarity.
Incorporate atmospheric backlighting (neon glow or spotlight) that matches the dominant color theme.
etalonnage: Dark/Moody: Deep blacks (#0D0D0D, #120A18) paired with vibrant neon accents in red (#FF2A2A), purple (#E1A6F4), or cyan (#00B4D8).
Summer/Resort: High-exposure palettes featuring bright whites (#FFFFFF), coral-reds (#E2584E), and sky blues (#3FA9F5).
effets: Subtle topographic vector line overlays and technical grid patterns.
Volumetric light rays, floating dust particles, and soft light blooms.
Fine photographic film grain combined with clean 3D game-engine renders.
logo: Place minimalist, single-color vector logos on the left third or top corners, aligned with thin accent underlines.
interdits: Do not use thick outer strokes or heavy black drop shadows on typography.
Avoid cluttered backgrounds; keep scenes atmospheric, blurred, or abstract.
Do not mix more than two distinct font families in a single composition.
Avoid flat, uniform lighting; never omit the high-contrast rim light on subjects.
personnages: Pose characters with a confident, relaxed, or intimidating attitude: hands holding cash, gesturing, or holding weapons in a low guard.
Dress characters in premium streetwear (hoodies, denim tube tops, knit vests, graphic tees) layered with heavy chrome/gold jewelry and designer sunglasses.
Render skin with a clean, semi-realistic 3D game engine finish, showing detailed tattoos and soft-painted textures.
Frame shots as vertical medium close-ups (waist-up) or dynamic full-body poses next to luxury assets like sports cars or music studio desks.
